# Could a public package be substituted for your internal one?

> Paste your requirements.txt, pip.conf, package.json, and .npmrc and find the two configuration shapes behind every 2021 dependency-confusion incident: pip --extra-index-url, and an unscoped npm dependency name behind a private registry. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded, no network calls.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
